question: Pandit Birju Maharaj was an Indian dancer, composer, singer, and exponent of the __________ "Kalka-Bindadin" Gharana of Kathak dance in India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lucknow**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pandit Birju Maharaj** was an Indian dancer, composer, singer, and exponent of the "Kalka-Bindadin" Gharana of Kathak dance in India.
 
• The "Kalka-Bindadin" Gharana is associated with the **Lucknow** style of Kathak dance.
 
• Birju Maharaj was renowned for his mastery in Kathak and contributed significantly to its popularization both in India and internationally.
 
• He received several prestigious awards, including the Padma Vibhushan, India's second-highest civilian award.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kathak** is one of the eight major forms of Indian classical dance.
 
• The word "Kathak" is derived from the Sanskrit word "Katha," meaning story, and "Kathakar," meaning the one who tells a story.
 
• The dance form traces its origins to the ancient North Indian temples where the Kathakars, or storytellers, used to narrate stories from epics and mythology through dance and music.
 
• The Lucknow Gharana of Kathak emphasizes graceful movements, intricate footwork, and expressive facial gestures.
 
• Pandit Birju Maharaj was instrumental in choreographing dance sequences for several Bollywood films, bringing Kathak to a wider audience.
